Q_SR1.derivation: Selected for RDS(on)=1mΩ, V_DS=40V (3× Vout), I_D=100A (10× Iout). Conduction loss = I²RMS × RDS(on) = 7² × 0.001 = 0.05W << 1.2W target.
Q_SR1.margin: 40V rating provides 2.26× margin over 17.7V peak secondary voltage. RDS(on) loss only 0.04% of output power.

Q_SR2.reference: Matched to Q_SR1 for balanced rectification
Q_SR2.derivation: Identical to Q_SR1. Matched pair ensures equal heating and balanced current sharing.

R_SENSE1.derivation: I_RMS = 7A, power dissipation target < 0.5W. P = I²×R → R_max = 0.5W / 49A² = 10.2mΩ. Selected 10mΩ for voltage sensing resolution (70mV drop at 7A RMS).
R_SENSE1.margin: 0.49W dissipation at 0.5W rating (98% utilization). 2512 package handles this with adequate PCB copper.
R_SENSE1.notes: Optional - DNF if current sensing not needed. Eliminating saves 1W total (both resistors).

R_SENSE2.derivation: Matched to R_SENSE1 for balanced current sensing. Same 10mΩ value.
R_SENSE2.notes: Must match R_SENSE1 tolerance (1%) for accurate differential current measurement.

R_GD1.reference: UCC24610 datasheet SLUSB94D, typical application. Standard SR gate pull-down.
R_GD1.derivation: Pull-down must overcome gate leakage (<100nA) and prevent false turn-on. 10kΩ provides 250µA at Vgs_th=2.5V, sinks 1.2mA from driver (negligible vs 2.5A drive capability).
R_GD1.margin: Pull-down current 2500× gate leakage. Loads driver by only 0.05%.

R_GD2.derivation: Identical to R_GD1. Both SR FETs use same pull-down value.

C_VCC.derivation: Gate charge per transition: Q_g = 70nC. Capacitor must supply 2× Q_g per switching cycle (both SR FETs). C = Q/ΔV = 140nC / 0.5V = 280nF minimum. Selected 1µF (3.6× margin).
C_VCC.margin: 1µF provides 3.6× margin over 280nF minimum. Handles transient gate drive current (35mA average) without voltage droop.
C_VCC.notes: Place close to gate driver VCC pin to minimize loop inductance during fast gate transients.

C_BST1.derivation: Standard bootstrap value for gate charge up to 100nC. BSC010N04LS Q_g = 70nC < 100nC.
C_BST1.notes: DNF by default - only fit if gate driver topology requires bootstrap. Low-side SR FETs typically don't need bootstrap.

C_BST2.derivation: Identical to C_BST1. Matched bootstrap caps if needed.
C_BST2.notes: DNF by default - fit only if bootstrap topology used.

RMS_current_calculation.description: Center-tap rectifier, each FET conducts for 50% duty cycle
RMS_current_calculation.assumption: Sinusoidal current waveform approximation - actual LLC waveform is quasi-square, may differ by 10-15%

conduction_loss.description: Primary loss mechanism in SR FETs

sense_resistor_loss.description: Power dissipation in current sense resistors
sense_resistor_loss.note: Can be eliminated by DNF if telemetry not required
